title: Getaway to Vietnam with Grand World
alt: Train passing between houses on Hanoi train street
transport: Two domestic flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Hanoi and Halong Bay
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in the old quarter, near the cathedral

activities.name: Hanoi city tour with the train street
activities.description: The mausoleum and the Temple of Literature, the narrow lane where the train passes between the houses, and the canals of Mega Grand World.

activities.name: Halong Bay full day cruise
activities.description: A full day on the bay by boat among the limestone islands and the floating villages, back in Hanoi by evening.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: Two nights in the old quarter with a city day including the train street, and a full day cruise on Halong Bay.

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Ninh Binh, Da Nang and Hoi An
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the Da Nang beachfront

activities.name: Ninh Binh day tour with lunch
activities.description: South to Ninh Binh for a rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc, with lunch before the flight to the coast.

activities.name: Marble Mountains, Son Tra and the coconut forest
activities.match: Day Trip to Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula
activities.description: The caves and pagodas of the Marble Mountains, the Am Phu cave, the Son Tra peninsula, and a basket boat through the Cam Thanh coconut forest.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: A Ninh Binh day on the way out of the north, then two nights on the beachfront with the Marble Mountains and Hoi An.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.subtitle: Ba Na Hills and Saigon
stops.hotel: Acnos Grand Hotel, Ho Chi Minh
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Hotel in District 1, a short walk from Saigon square

activities.name: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
activities.match: Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge Day Tour
activities.description: The long cable car up to Ba Na, the Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands, and the French village and gardens at the top.

activities.name: Saigon city tour
activities.match: Half Day Ho Chi Minh City Tour
activities.description: The Reunification Palace, the old post office and Notre Dame cathedral, then the war remnants museum.

activities.name: Cu Chi tunnels with the shooting range
activities.description: The tunnel network north west of the city, the trapdoors and kitchens, and the range where you can fire a few rounds from an AK 47.

activities.name: Shopping tour at Saigon square
activities.match: Shopping Tour in Ho Chi Minh
activities.description: An afternoon through Saigon square and the market stalls around it, where the tailoring and the copies are cheapest.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: Ba Na Hills on the way south, then two nights in District 1 with the city, the tunnels and a shopping afternoon.

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: This is the busiest week we sell. Nine separate things in seven days, and still two flights to keep you off the road.
expert.tip: The train street is best in the late afternoon. Check the timetable with your guide, it changes without notice.

summary: A full week north to south: Hanoi with the train street and Mega Grand World, a full day cruise on Halong Bay, Ninh Binh with lunch, two nights on the Da Nang beachfront with the Marble Mountains and Hoi An, Ba Na Hills, then Saigon with the Cu Chi tunnels and a shopping afternoon.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast and dinner in Saigon; two domestic flights; private transfers throughout; a Hanoi city tour with the train street and Mega Grand World; a full day cruise on Halong Bay; a Ninh Binh day tour with lunch; the Marble Mountains, Son Tra peninsula and Cam Thanh basket boat day; a full day up at Ba Na with the Golden Bridge; a half day Saigon city tour; the Cu Chi tunnels with the shooting range; a shopping tour at Saigon square.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; other lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
